name: Git Auto Commit
description: Automatically commits files which have been changed during the workflow run and push changes back to remote repository.

branch.description: Git branch name, where changes should be pushed too. Required if Action is used on the `pull_request` event

file_pattern.description: File pattern used for `git add`. For example `src/*.js`

repository.description: Local file path to the git repository. Defaults to the current directory (`.`)

commit_user_name.description: Name used for the commit user

commit_user_email.description: Email address used for the commit user

commit_author.description: Value used for the commit author. Defaults to the username of whoever triggered this workflow run.

tag_name.description: Tag name used for creating a new git tag with the commit. Keep this empty, if no tag should be created.

tagging_message.description: Tagging message used for creating a new git tag with the commit. Keep this empty, if no tag should be created.

skip_dirty_check.description: Skip the check if the git repository is dirty and always try to create a commit.

disable_globbing.description: Stop the shell from expanding filenames (https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/html_node/Filename-Expansion.html)

create_branch.description: Create new branch with the name of `branch`-input in local and remote repository, if it doesn't exist yet.

create_git_tag_only.description: Perform a clean git tag and push, without commiting anything

internal_git_binary.description: Internal use only! Path to git binary used to check if git is available. (Don't change this!)
